title_i18n.en: Who Gets to Say Who We Are?

description_i18n.en: Cross borders, histories, and imagined worlds to explore how identity is assigned, defended, inherited, and reclaimed.

note_i18n.en: Begin with identity held in landscape, memory, and belonging.
Move to a border community where language complicates the map.
Examine the boxes imposed by a racial system built to divide.
Ask what happens when nationality speaks before the individual can.
Consider what can be preserved when a larger story claims ownership.
End in an imagined world where identity and power are negotiated anew.
